verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's RTX 5080 page explicitly positions the card for local AI inference. It cites curated, GPU-optimized SDKs and models with maximized performance across Windows ML, Ollama, PyTorch and other inference backends, and says the latest AI models run locally. That is a first-party, documented inference-stack story, but a thin one, and nothing ties fifth-gen Tensor Cores to specific low-precision formats. missing for 10: any documentation of FP8/FP4 support on this part, explicit TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/llama.cpp support for the 5080, LLM-specific guidance (e.g. model sizes that fit in 16 GB), independent hands-on LLM inference benchmarks.
